selection_history: Freeze all four member exit variants after the static budget diagnostic and before restored-account returns. No choice of winning pool, phase, size, mode or threshold
restoration: Only while original members are partly retired, raise gold/bond goals toward the same-date scaled neutral goals. Keep all stock goals exactly unchanged. unchanged: Admission scores, original member identities, stock donor quota, member funding/expiry/timeout clocks, cooldown, immediate risk exits, fees and trading engine unchanged; restore_defensive defaults false
compatibility: 120 previous defaults across four pools and two fees, full account/metrics/check exact, inverse trace canonical JSON exact. Only controller, independent auditor and shared research driver may differ
retention: 432 formal runs =120 compatibility +192 timing/cost +120 fresh; 8 fresh defaults reused. Retain32 full new defaults; audit every account before compacting. Include9 continuous-account bull/bear/observation episodes and matched no-restoration comparisons
scope: Overlapping previously studied survivor NAV histories and model contracts, not unseen holdout or verified executable investment performance. Predicted volatility is not a drawdown guarantee. No automatic trial promotion or live orders
